gen-orbitron-gf-lexend-mega: Orbitron spreads its letters far apart along the line, each e showing a large, clear eye. Lexend Mega meets that with a friendly, modern sans-serif drawn as if with one nib, so the pair feels precise yet approachable.
gen-orbitron-gf-lexend-peta: Orbitron brings minimal, precisely spaced letters with open apertures to the heading. And Lexend Peta follows in a plain sans with curves that never thin out, wide-mouthed c shapes and a big x-height, giving the page a sturdy footing.
gen-orbitron-gf-lexend-tera: Lexend Tera draws a single-weight line like a plotter pen, with every rounded letter standing open and far apart. Lexend Tera against the large-eyed, widely spaced Orbitron makes a pair whose strongest quality is its crisp, contemporary spacing.
gen-orbitron-gf-lexend-zetta: Orbitron is minimal and precise, with a large eye on every e. Lexend Zetta takes over below as a widely tracked sans of ribbon-like strokes and tall small letters, so give its size a little restraint.
gen-orbitron-gf-montserrat-alternates: Orbitron leads with minimal, far-spaced letters and generous apertures, while Montserrat Alternates settles underneath with round, chalk-board lowercase that crowds toward the capital line. Paragraphs would feel dense yet friendly.
gen-outfit-fs-literata: Outfit draws inviting geometric letters with a marker-like plainness, its t crossbar and stem sharing one width. Literata then adds a bookish serif whose gentle stroke variation and open curves give the page a warmer, more sophisticated counterpoint.
gen-pirata-one-archivo: Gothic and commanding, Pirata One packs its letters nose to tail above a tall lowercase zone, while Archivo uses a confident x-height and outward-opening curves. A longer passage would read smoothly and approachably.
gen-pirata-one-fs-asap: Tightly packed, gothic letters define Pirata One at a glance. Asap sits beneath as a sans-serif with open arcs and a body height nearly matching its capitals, so the two feel like a dark banner over a practical text.
gen-pirata-one-fs-be-vietnam-pro: Be Vietnam Pro reads like a bent steel rod, a plain sans with curve endings that never approach each other. And Pirata One, with its gothic nose-to-tail letters and compact ascender space, gives that restraint a darker, more commanding headline.
gen-pirata-one-fs-epilogue: Approachable, with a neon-tube consistency in every stroke. Epilogue is a plain sans with a tall-bodied lowercase and stubby ascender tips, so a longer passage under gothic Pirata One would feel smooth, contemporary and unclamped.
